svg.title: NWDAF data pipeline end-to-end flow
svg.desc: Two ingestion paths feed SingleStore, which serves three downstream microservices and is managed by a scheduler.

g.onclick: sendPrompt('What kind of metrics do the network functions emit?')
sendPrompt('What are IPFix records and IPv6 packets used for here?')
sendPrompt('Why does Prometheus federation scrape every 15 seconds?')
sendPrompt('Why Kafka and Spark for the streaming path?')
sendPrompt('What does the Golang adapter actually do with remote_write?')

svg.text: 3. Storage + ETL (SingleStore / MemSQL — acts as lake + warehouse + feature store)

g.onclick: sendPrompt('What raw tables exist and how are they written?')
sendPrompt('How do the SQL stored procedures aggregate data with time_bucket?')
sendPrompt('Why use Rowstore for the feature store?')
sendPrompt('How does the AI service use the last 60 timestamps for TCN/LSTM forecasting?')
sendPrompt('How does getQoeAvgStatistics calculate Mean Opinion Score?')
sendPrompt('How does the scheduler enforce retention without breaking live traffic?')
sendPrompt('Why gRPC instead of REST for serving network functions?')
